listingTitle: VASAGLE Bathroom Floor Cabinet, 2 Drawers, 35" H, Cloud White
listingLines: Every Inch Counts: Don't neglect the corner space of your home! Max out storage space and keep your everyday essentials at your fingertips by opting for this slimline 11.8"D x 11.8"W x 35"H freestanding cabinet

Durable-Meets-Versatile: Made from sturdy engineered wood, this floor cabinet with a simple design and classic white finish is not only built to withstand everyday use, but also looks striking in your living room, bathroom, hallway, study, and more
In Sight or Out of Sight?: It's up to you! This clever storage cabinet boasts a super-handy open shelf for your oft-used items, while 2 spacious drawers to hide not-so-pretty items

The Easier, the Better: With numbered parts provided, the assembly has never been this fast and easy—simply tighten the screws with the easy-to-follow instructions and you’ll have this corner unit set up in no time
What You Get: A freestanding storage cabinet that creates a country-yet-modern aesthetic that mixes flair and function, with an open shelf and 2 drawers for a clean, mess-free space
summary: This is a slimline, freestanding floor cabinet designed to maximize storage space in your home. It helps keep everyday essentials organized and hidden, creating a clean and mess-free environment.
